title: Export the filtered claims list to CSV

fields.summary: As a caseworker, I want to export the claims list I am viewing to CSV, so that I can share it with my manager.
fields.completion_goal:
1. [api-trace] state: claims list filtered by status Open across 3 pages; expected: the downloaded CSV holds every Open claim and no other
2. [api-trace] state: export with the Region column hidden; expected: the CSV header lists exactly the visible columns, without Region
3. [recording] state: claims list with 12,000 claims; expected: the list still scrolls and responds to clicks while the file is prepared
fields.scenario: Filter the claims list to Open, hide the Region column, export, and open the file; repeat with 12,000 seeded claims while scrolling.
